headline: UNIDO will mobilise around $40 million from international donors and investors for a dedicated development programme in Sindh, agreed between Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah and UNIDO Deputy Director General Fatou Haidara at the CM House in Karachi.

card.desc: CM Murad Shah, UNIDO agree five-year Sindh development push.

caption:
UNIDO will mobilise around $40 million from international donors and investors for a dedicated development programme in Sindh, Dawn reports. The plan, agreed between CM Murad Ali Shah and UNIDO's Fatou Haidara, targets rural development, climate-resilient infrastructure and jobs, Express Tribune adds.
